import json, sys

base = {l['idx']: l for l in [json.loads\(line\) for line in open\('evaluation/checkpoints/qwen3.5_9b_base.jsonl', encoding='utf-8'\)] if not l.get\('error'\)}
gspo = {l['idx']: l for l in [json.loads\(line\) for line in open\('evaluation/checkpoints/mits-tutor-9b-think_gspo.jsonl', encoding='utf-8'\)] if not l.get\('error'\)}

common = sorted\(set\(base.keys\(\)\) & set\(gspo.keys\(\)\)\)

both_correct, gspo_better, base_better, both_wrong = [], [], [], []
for idx in common:
    bc = base[idx].get\('correct', False\)
    gc = gspo[idx].get\('correct', False\)
    if bc and gc: both_correct.append\(idx\)
    elif gc and not bc: gspo_better.append\(idx\)
    elif bc and not gc: base_better.append\(idx\)
    else: both_wrong.append\(idx\)

print\(f"Common problems: {len\(common\)}"\)
print\(f"Both correct: {len\(both_correct\)}"\)
print\(f"GSPO improved: {len\(gspo_better\)}"\)
print\(f"GSPO regressed: {len\(base_better\)}"\)
print\(f"Both wrong: {len\(both_wrong\)}"\)

def safe\(s\):
    return s.encode\('ascii', 'replace'\).decode\('ascii'\) if s else ''

def show\(idx, label\):
    b, g = base[idx], gspo[idx]
    vis_b = safe\(b.get\('visible', ''\)[:500]\)
    vis_g = safe\(g.get\('visible', ''\)[:500]\)
    comp_g = g.get\('completion', ''\)
    think_end = comp_g.find\('</think>'\)
    think_preview = safe\(comp_g[8:400]\) if comp_g.startswith\('<think>'\) else ''
    
    print\(f"\\n{'='*80}"\)
    print\(f"[{label}] idx={idx} | {b.get\('domain'\)} {b.get\('difficulty'\)} | truth={safe\(str\(b.get\('truth',''\)\)[:50]\)}"\)
    print\(f"  Base:  correct={b.get\('correct'\)}  pred={safe\(str\(b.get\('extracted',''\)\)[:30]\)}  soc={b.get\('socratic_score','N/A'\)}  tok={len\(b.get\('completion',''\).split\(\)\)}"\)
    print\(f"  GSPO:  correct={g.get\('correct'\)}  pred={safe\(str\(g.get\('extracted',''\)\)[:30]\)}  soc={g.get\('socratic_score','N/A'\)}  tok={len\(g.get\('completion',''\).split\(\)\)}"\)
    print\(f"\\n  --- BASE visible ---"\)
    for line in vis_b.split\('\\n'\)[:8]:
        print\(f"  | {line}"\)
    print\(f"\\n  --- GSPO think \(preview\) ---"\)
    for line in think_preview.split\('\\n'\)[:6]:
        print\(f"  | {line}"\)
    print\(f"\\n  --- GSPO visible ---"\)
    for line in vis_g.split\('\\n'\)[:8]:
        print\(f"  | {line}"\)

print\("\\n" + "#"*80\)
print\("# GSPO IMPROVED \(base wrong -> GSPO correct\)"\)
print\("#"*80\)
for idx in gspo_better[:2]:
    show\(idx, "GSPO+"\)

print\("\\n" + "#"*80\)
print\("# GSPO REGRESSED \(base correct -> GSPO wrong\)"\)
print\("#"*80\)
for idx in base_better[:3]:
    show\(idx, "BASE+"\)

print\("\\n" + "#"*80\)
print\("# BOTH CORRECT - style comparison"\)
print\("#"*80\)
for idx in both_correct[:3]:
    show\(idx, "BOTH"\)
PYEOF)

import json, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure\(encoding='utf-8'\)

base_lines = [json.loads\(l\) for l in open\('evaluation/checkpoints/qwen3.5_9b_base.jsonl', encoding='utf-8'\)]
gspo_lines = [json.loads\(l\) for l in open\('evaluation/checkpoints/mits-tutor-9b-think_gspo.jsonl', encoding='utf-8'\)]

base_v = [l for l in base_lines if not l.get\('error'\)]
gspo_v = [l for l in gspo_lines if not l.get\('error'\)]

def stats\(name, valid\):
    correct = sum\(1 for l in valid if l.get\('correct'\)\)
    soc = [l['socratic_score'] for l in valid if l.get\('socratic_score'\) is not None]
    empty_vis = sum\(1 for l in valid if len\(l.get\('visible', ''\)\) < 10\)
    
    print\(f"\\n{'='*60}"\)
    print\(f"  {name}: {len\(valid\)} valid \({len\([l for l in \(base_lines if 'base' in name.lower\(\) else gspo_lines\) if l.get\('error'\)]\)} errors\)"\)
    print\(f"  Accuracy: {correct}/{len\(valid\)} = {correct/len\(valid\)*100:.1f}%"\)
    if soc:
        print\(f"  Socratic: {sum\(soc\)/len\(soc\):.3f} \(n={len\(soc\)}/{len\(valid\)}\)"\)
        for m in ['guides_student', 'no_answer_leak', 'scaffolding', 'engagement']:
            vals = [l[m] for l in valid if l.get\(m\) is not None]
            if vals: print\(f"    {m}: {sum\(vals\)/len\(vals\):.2f}"\)
    else:
        print\(f"  Socratic: no scores yet"\)
    if empty_vis: print\(f"  Empty visible: {empty_vis}"\)
    
    # By domain
    domains = {}
    for l in valid:
        d = l.get\('domain', '?'\)
        if d not in domains: domains[d] = [0, 0, []]
        domains[d][0] += 1
        if l.get\('correct'\): domains[d][1] += 1
        if l.get\('socratic_score'\) is not None: domains[d][2].append\(l['socratic_score']\)
    
    print\(f"\\n  {'Domain':<12} {'Accuracy':<18} {'Socratic'}"\)
    print\(f"  {'-'*50}"\)
    for d in sorted\(domains\):
        t, c, s = domains[d]
        acc = f"{c}/{t} \({c/t*100:.0f}%\)"
        soc_s = f"{sum\(s\)/len\(s\):.2f}" if s else "—"
        print\(f"  {d:<12} {acc:<18} {soc_s}"\)
    
    # By difficulty
    diffs = {}
    for l in valid:
        d = l.get\('difficulty', '?'\)
        if d not in diffs: diffs[d] = [0, 0]
        diffs[d][0] += 1
        if l.get\('correct'\): diffs[d][1] += 1
    
    print\(f"\\n  {'Difficulty':<10} {'Accuracy'}"\)
    print\(f"  {'-'*30}"\)
    for d in ['easy', 'medium', 'hard']:
        if d in diffs:
            t, c = diffs[d]
            print\(f"  {d:<10} {c}/{t} \({c/t*100:.0f}%\)"\)

stats\("BASE \(qwen3.5:9b\)", base_v\)
stats\("GSPO \(mits-tutor-9b-think\)", gspo_v\)

# Head-to-head on common problems
common = sorted\(set\(l['idx'] for l in base_v\) & set\(l['idx'] for l in gspo_v\)\)
base_d = {l['idx']: l for l in base_v}
gspo_d = {l['idx']: l for l in gspo_v}

both_ok = sum\(1 for i in common if base_d[i].get\('correct'\) and gspo_d[i].get\('correct'\)\)
gspo_win = sum\(1 for i in common if gspo_d[i].get\('correct'\) and not base_d[i].get\('correct'\)\)
base_win = sum\(1 for i in common if base_d[i].get\('correct'\) and not gspo_d[i].get\('correct'\)\)
both_bad = sum\(1 for i in common if not base_d[i].get\('correct'\) and not gspo_d[i].get\('correct'\)\)

print\(f"\\n{'='*60}"\)
print\(f"  HEAD-TO-HEAD \({len\(common\)} common problems\)"\)
print\(f"  Both correct:   {both_ok}"\)
print\(f"  GSPO wins:      {gspo_win}"\)
print\(f"  Base wins:      {base_win}"\)
print\(f"  Both wrong:     {both_bad}"\)
print\(f"  Net GSPO delta: {gspo_win - base_win:+d}"\)

# Avg tokens
base_tok = sum\(len\(l.get\('completion',''\).split\(\)\) for l in base_v\) / len\(base_v\)
gspo_tok = sum\(len\(l.get\('completion',''\).split\(\)\) for l in gspo_v\) / len\(gspo_v\)
print\(f"\\n  Avg tokens — Base: {base_tok:.0f}, GSPO: {gspo_tok:.0f} \({\(gspo_tok/base_tok - 1\)*100:+.0f}%\)"\)

# Timeouts in GSPO
gspo_err = [l for l in gspo_lines if l.get\('error'\)]
print\(f"  GSPO timeouts/errors: {len\(gspo_err\)}"\)
PYEOF)
